Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the helpful demo last week. We’re ready to kick off the 3-month pilot, but I need to flag two operational items before we can issue the PO:

1) Payment cadence: our finance org runs a central AP cycle that often pays on Net60 for new vendors while vendor onboarding completes. Can Redwood accommodate Net60 for the first two invoices and then move to Net30 after successful onboarding?

2) Credit/limits: our expected consumption for the first 6 weeks could exceed the standard onboarding estimate. Would Redwood consider a short-term credit buffer (approx. 2–3x our baseline) while we finalize internal procurement?

We’ll provide a VAT certificate and PO as soon as the legal terms are confirmed — attaching our procurement lead for any questions (finance@novapulse.io).

Appreciate any flexibility here; this pilot is time-sensitive for us.

Best,
Elena Rossi

Elena — thanks for the clear note and congrats on moving to pilot. Short answer: we can be flexible, but I want to propose a compromise that balances your runway with our risk controls so the pilot can start without delay.

Proposal:
- Net45 for the first three invoices (covering the 3-month pilot + onboarding), then revert to Net30 thereafter.
- Temporary credit buffer at 1.5x the agreed monthly baseline for 60 days. We can reevaluate and expand once we have consumption history (fast path to increase after first two invoices cleared).

What we need from your side to accelerate approval:
- VAT registration certificate (EU VAT) or VAT number (we can accept a scanned PDF)
- Signed proforma / PO indicating the pilot start date (I’ve attached a proforma for signature).
- Quick trading reference or payment history for Net terms (finance@novapulse.io contact is fine).

I’ve looped in Marissa (Finance) and Ben (Sales Ops) to expedite. I’ve attached a proforma invoice (proforma-ln-001.xlsx) with the temporary credit buffer reflected. If that looks good, send back the signed PO and I’ll route for approval.

If Net60 is an absolute mandate from procurement, say so and I’ll escalate — but Net45 + 1.5x buffer is typically something we can approve quickly.

Thanks,
